advisories.condition: Inbound SNI-specific mutual TLS falls back to a permissive default context.

advisories.condition: Deeply nested JSON reaches the old shaded parser.
advisories.assessment: Transitive Hadoop JSON paths remain incompletely proven; the direct Spark input parser is separately patched.

advisories.condition: The infocmp command processes malicious terminal-description input.
advisories.assessment: No terminal-description input or infocmp command is part of the reviewed pipeline.

advisories.condition: HTTP Digest authentication hashes collide for non-Latin credentials.
advisories.assessment: This advisory includes client authentication; disabling the Spark UI alone is insufficient. The pilot selects S3 signing rather than Jetty HTTP Digest authentication.

advisories.condition: Untrusted Java object streams deserialize Guava collections.
advisories.assessment: Selected Kafka input is JSON, output is Parquet, and Spark runs locally; arbitrary external Java object input is not configured.

advisories.condition: SQLite FTS5 processes adversarial tables and prefix queries.
advisories.assessment: No SQLite input or FTS service is selected; the library remains installed and no package fix is claimed.

advisories.condition: SQLite deletes from a malicious FTS5 index.
advisories.assessment: The demo accepts blockchain events rather than SQLite database files; no exhaustive dependency call-path claim is made.

advisories.condition: SQLite applies a crafted session changeset.
advisories.assessment: No SQLite changeset ingestion is configured; affected library code remains installed.

advisories.condition: A privileged systemd-homed service changes managed-user group membership.
advisories.assessment: The exact installed images have neither systemd-homed nor homectl; shared source-package libraries remain reported.

advisories.condition: An HTTP parser accepts ambiguous quoted chunk extensions.
advisories.assessment: No Jetty HTTP service is launched by the selected workload; this is a role/configuration candidate, not removal of its parser.

advisories.condition: HTTP request parsers disagree about quoted chunk extensions.
advisories.assessment: The selected SDK role is an outbound client; no SDK inbound HTTP request service is configured.

advisories.condition: An HTTP/2 endpoint processes an unbounded continuation-frame sequence.
advisories.assessment: Observed Hadoop HTTP-client defaults use HTTP/1.1; no HTTP/2 server is launched. Future protocol changes invalidate the assessment.

advisories.condition: A Netty LZ4 frame decoder trusts peer-controlled allocation lengths.
advisories.assessment: No LZ4 decoder construction was found in the inspected SDK HTTP-client source; installed codec code remains.

advisories.condition: HTTP/1.1 pipelining combines HEAD, informational responses and unsafe reuse.
advisories.assessment: This is a client-side advisory; outbound-only operation does not dismiss it. Pipelining prerequisites were not separately tested.

advisories.condition: Compressed HTTP content bypasses advertised allocation limits.
advisories.assessment: No decompressor construction was found in inspected SDK client source, but complete transitive response-path absence is not proven.

advisories.condition: An application relies on Netty IPv6 subnet filtering for authorization.
advisories.assessment: No Netty subnet-filter policy is configured; required AWS ingress and container controls remain separate prerequisites.

advisories.condition: An inbound TLS ClientHello handler eagerly allocates peer-declared buffers.
advisories.assessment: The inspected SDK TLS role is client-only, not an inbound SNI service.

advisories.condition: A supplied plain trust manager loses endpoint-identification context.
advisories.assessment: The installed Hadoop async-builder has no custom trust provider or trust-all flag; an explicit JDK handler has HTTPS endpoint identification. No handshake or every-provider proof is claimed.

advisories.condition: A privileged caller performs pathname-based ACL operations on mutable paths.
advisories.assessment: The applications run non-root without capabilities, with read-only roots and no-new-privileges; host ACL administration is outside scope.

advisories.condition: Polymorphic deserialization accepts attacker-chosen generic type identifiers.
advisories.assessment: Direct pilot code does not enable polymorphic typing; absence from every transitive Hadoop mapper is not proven.

advisories.condition: Array subtype allowlisting permits unapproved element classes.
advisories.assessment: No such validator configuration is selected by pilot code; transitive configuration remains uncertain.

advisories.condition: A configured SPDY decoder accepts excessive SETTINGS entries.
advisories.assessment: Observed HTTP-client defaults are HTTP/1.1; no SPDY handler construction was found in the inspected client source.

advisories.condition: SPDY header inflation continues after size rejection.
advisories.assessment: SPDY is not selected by the observed defaults; vulnerable codec classes remain installed.

advisories.condition: A running JLine Telnet service accepts excessive environment variables.
advisories.assessment: No Telnet service is launched; the old relocated classes remain inside Hadoop.

advisories.condition: A running JLine Telnet service renders excessive terminal dimensions.
advisories.assessment: No Telnet or interactive terminal service is launched by the selected pipeline.

advisories.condition: SPDY-to-HTTP state handling leaks buffers on stream errors.
advisories.assessment: No SPDY-to-HTTP service or handler is selected by the pilot configuration.

advisories.condition: HTTP/2 decompression error paths leak direct buffers.
advisories.assessment: Observed defaults use HTTP/1.1; no HTTP/2 decompressor construction was found in the inspected client source.

advisories.condition: A malformed bzip2 stream reaches a Netty compression decoder.
advisories.assessment: No bzip2 decoder construction was found in inspected client source; dynamic or future pipelines are not certified.

advisories.condition: An asynchronous numeric parser accumulates incomplete streamed numbers.
advisories.assessment: Specific old-parser path is not exercised by the pilot tests; scanner-to-upstream advisory mapping retained without inventing a CVE alias.

advisories.condition: Privileged mount helpers run post-mount operations after helper failure.
advisories.assessment: Setuid bits are cleared, capabilities dropped and privilege elevation blocked. Vulnerable package code is retained.

advisories.condition: A JLine shell evaluates attacker-controlled grep patterns.
advisories.assessment: The pipeline is not a remote interactive JLine shell and exposes no grep command service.

advisories.condition: A privileged operator enters a hostile cgroup namespace and inherits descriptors.
advisories.assessment: No privileged nsenter operation is selected; containers have no namespace-administration capabilities.

advisories.condition: A privileged subdirectory mount resolves an attacker-controlled path.
advisories.assessment: No container mount administration is authorized; executable privilege bits are cleared. Vendor vulnerable status is retained.

advisories.condition: A privileged bind-mount operation follows mutable source paths.
advisories.assessment: No mount privileges or setuid helpers remain in the app images. Host EBS operations remain a separate gated activity.

advisories.condition: Malformed tokens reach a DataInput-based JSON parser.
advisories.assessment: No adversarial parser test was run against vulnerable code; transitive path uncertainty remains.

advisories.condition: Unknown named type identifiers fill a fallback-deserializer cache.
advisories.assessment: No direct annotated fallback model is selected; retained shaded code and indirect model use remain visible.

advisories.condition: Object-identity collections resolve adversarial references in reverse order.
advisories.assessment: No direct object-identity model is selected; all transitive JSON paths are not certified.

advisories.condition: Perl Archive::Tar processes an adversarial archive entry length.
advisories.assessment: The exact installed images cannot load Archive::Tar because its module is absent; raw source-package scanner status is preserved.

advisories.condition: Unvalidated input enters CloudFront signed-policy utilities.
advisories.assessment: The workload uses S3 and does not invoke CloudFront signing utilities. The broad SDK bundle remains installed.
